title: 13 cases. Trials in respect of 2,84,774 cases were completed during the year out of which 1,89,401 cases (66·5%) ended in conviction. Table II(b) presents a comparative picture of (i) the percentage of cases charge-sheeted to total true cases (ii) Percentage of conviction to total true cases investigated and (iii) Percentage of conviction to total cases in which trials were completed during the last five years from 1963 to 1967. The pattern is more or less the same as in the previous years.
